title: CognitiveOS Personal handbook page frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of every handbook Markdown page. The handbook is an informative derived layer: frontmatter never creates task, Gate, contract, or release facts.

doc_id.description: Stable locale-independent identifier. The same doc_id must exist in every locale tree.

kind.description: navigation and meta pages carry no capability status; every other kind requires one.

status.description: Capability status of the page's primary subject, judged from code + contracts + tests together. Never copied from docs/plan/PROGRESS.md.

generated.description: true when the page body is produced by tools/src/generate-handbook.mjs and must never be hand-edited.

path.description: Repo-relative tracked path (forward slashes). Must exist and be tracked.

symbols.description: Stable symbols that must literally appear in the source file. Never line numbers.

contracts.description: Canonical machine/behavior contract paths this page's normative statements link to.

tests.description: Test files or suites that prove the described behavior.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 over the domain-separated, sorted (path NUL LF-normalized-bytes) concatenation of all sources[].path files. See _meta/generation.md.

non_claims.description: Explicit statements of what this page does NOT claim (Gate, release, Profile, platform parity, benefit).
